cluster_stories.title: US says BYD, Baidu and Alibaba are aiding China's military
cluster_stories.summary: America has released a new list of Chinese companies it believes support Beijing's military. Major firms like Alibaba, Baidu, and BYD are included. Other companies like WuXi AppTec and RoboSense Technology are also on the list. While not imposing immediate sanctions, the Pentagon will stop contracting with these firms in the future.
